methodology: Portfolio Manager: 페르소나 aggregate stance score + thesis lens score 결합 signal × Risk Manager position limit = target value. Signal score range [-1.0, +1.0]. Action mapping: >+0.5 = buy_full, +0.2~0.5 = buy, -0.2~+0.2 = hold, -0.2~-0.5 = trim, <-0.5 = sell_all.
